questions.stem: Which of the following is not true regarding the process of "NETosis"?

options.label: C
options.text: Detected in blood in patients with sepsis

options.label: D
options.text: Plays a role in the pathogenesis of SLE

questions.solutionHtml:
Chromatin condensation
  • NETosis, e. the process of formation of Neutrophil Extracellular Traps (NETS): Extracellular fibrillar networks that concentrate antimicrobial substances at sites of infection and trap microbes, helping to prevent their spread.
  • NET formation starts with ROS-dependent activation of an arginine deaminase that converts arginine to citrulline, leading to chromatin decondensation.



Robbins & Cotran Pathologic Basis of Disease, 10th Edition, Page No. 83, 84
